div.div: 5 تفزّر It (a garment, or piece of cloth,) became rent, or slit; (K;) as also ↓ انفزر ; (O, * K;) and ↓ فَزَرَ , inf. n. فُزُورٌ; (Msb; [but see فَزَرٌ, below;]) and so the like thereof; (Msb;) and the same is said of a wall: (TA:) and it (a garment, or piece of cloth,) became dissundered, ragged, tattered, or shabby, and old and worn out; (S, TA;) as also ↓ انفزر . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
